title: Five Classrooms Across Three Thousand Years
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mediterranean Travels
description: Interactive infographic overlay comparing five classrooms from the route, from the Lyceum to a modern tutoring room, with hover tooltips, a click-to-open infobox, and a quiz mode.

educational.topic: Who could learn: five classrooms and the Learning for All pattern
learningObjectives: Compare five classrooms from the route, from the Lyceum to a modern tutoring room.
For each classroom, state who was inside, what opened the door, and who was still left outside.
prerequisites: Chapter 2: the four-step Learning for All pattern

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Side-by-side comparison followed by retrieval practice
keyQuestions: Who was inside, and who was still left outside?
What opened the door, and who resisted?
What does the modern room keep from the older ones?
commonMisconceptions: The five classrooms are steps on a ladder of progress.
A technology that lowers cost reaches everyone.
Free tuition means open to everyone.
assessmentOpportunities: Ten-question quiz mode: click the classroom that matches each idea

controls.name: Explore
controls.description: Default mode: hover a classroom for a tooltip, click it for the infobox.

controls.name: Quiz Mode
controls.description: Hides the name pills and asks ten questions answered by clicking a classroom.
